effort: none: opencode 1.19.6 run --variant silently drops a variant the model lacks (packages/opencode/src/session/llm/request.ts, anomalyco/opencode v1.19.6)
login: opencode's own login, saved by `opencode auth login` in ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json, or a provider API-key variable you set yourself
daemon: opencode run (1.19.6, no --attach) starts no background service and serves itself in-process; its shell tool, LSP and MCP children run detached in their own sessions and can outlive the turn; stop ends them with the process tree
